He sits in a compact warm orange leather bistro chair with dark wood legs, facing right in slight three-quarter view. A NARROW small round wooden pedestal table is directly in front of his lap; the tabletop is about chair-seat width, with one white ceramic plate holding a simple colorful meal. Table, chair, feet, torso and satchel never move between frames. Warm refined dimensional hand-painted cozy game finish, fine cloth/leather/wood details and a clean silhouette matching references. Entire person, chair, bag and complete table including its foot visible in each cell. Each complete vignette NARROWER THAN ITS HEIGHT and fits only 75 percent of its quarter-cell width; occupy approximately 55 percent of total canvas height. Generous transparent margins on all sides and clear transparent gaps between all four figures. No overlapping poses or clipped shoes/table edges. Alpha fully transparent outside figure and furniture. No room, floor, cast shadow, haze, glow, labels, writing or grid. Consistent game sprites, not a poster.
